notes: Wire protocol reasonCode values remain unchanged. errorId is an operator-facing stable code mapped to reasonCode.

entries.title: Critical command ACK timeout
entries.operatorAction: Check Quest connectivity, keep app in foreground, then retry.

entries.title: Transport disconnected
entries.operatorAction: Reconnect controller to headset and retry.

entries.title: No active TCP route
entries.operatorAction: Verify Quest is reachable on the same network.

entries.title: Transport closed
entries.operatorAction: Re-open controller connection and retry.

entries.title: Socket closed
entries.operatorAction: Reconnect the session transport.

entries.title: Envelope command mismatch
entries.operatorAction: Use matching mobile and Quest builds.

entries.title: Envelope message id mismatch
entries.operatorAction: Retry command once; if repeated, restart session.

entries.title: Envelope issuedAt is invalid
entries.operatorAction: Check device clock and retry.

entries.title: Envelope expiresAt is invalid
entries.operatorAction: Retry using fresh command payload.

entries.title: Envelope expired before processing
entries.operatorAction: Retry command immediately.

entries.title: Active session lock conflict
entries.operatorAction: Finish or re-attach to the active session.

entries.title: Session ownership conflict
entries.operatorAction: Confirm therapist/student pairing before retry.

entries.title: Missing ownership metadata
entries.operatorAction: Ensure controller sends ownerKey/sessionKey and retry.

entries.title: No command handler on Quest runtime
entries.operatorAction: Use a build with matching runtime command support.

entries.title: Command payload deserialization failed
entries.operatorAction: Verify payload contract and build compatibility.

entries.title: Quest command handler exception
entries.operatorAction: Collect runtime logs and retry after restart.

entries.title: Command already in progress
entries.operatorAction: Wait briefly and retry once.

entries.title: Duplicate command idempotency hit
entries.operatorAction: No action unless user-facing flow is blocked.

entries.title: Unspecified ACK/NACK reason
entries.operatorAction: Inspect logs and retry command.

entries.title: Session is not active
entries.operatorAction: Attach or resume session before sending command.

entries.title: Temporary command rejection
entries.operatorAction: Retry command after a short delay.

entries.title: Entitlement profile missing
entries.operatorAction: Ask admin operator to create entitlement profile.

entries.title: App license inactive
entries.operatorAction: Ask admin operator to activate app license.

entries.title: Entitlement backend unavailable
entries.operatorAction: Verify network/backend health and retry login.

entries.title: Role undefined
entries.operatorAction: Assign allowed role in entitlement profile.

entries.title: Legacy fallback without entitlement record
entries.operatorAction: Create proper entitlement profile for this operator.

entries.title: Legacy fallback due to entitlement backend error
entries.operatorAction: Check Firestore availability, then validate strict gate path.

entries.title: App license active
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Headset app paused/backgrounded
entries.operatorAction: Ask student to bring VR app to foreground.

entries.title: Headset app resumed
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Headset app focus lost
entries.operatorAction: Keep app focused; avoid system overlays.

entries.title: Headset app focus regained
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Headset app quitting
entries.operatorAction: Reopen VR app and wait for reconnect.

entries.title: TCP client connected
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: No runtime signal timeout
entries.operatorAction: Reconnect; ensure headset app is active.

entries.title: Runtime signal stale
entries.operatorAction: Reconnect and verify runtime heartbeat.

entries.title: TCP link lost
entries.operatorAction: Restore same-network connection.

entries.title: Initial controller connect
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Auto reconnect
entries.operatorAction: No action needed unless reconnect loops.

entries.title: Session attach handshake
entries.operatorAction: No action needed unless attach retries repeatedly.

entries.title: Session id required
entries.operatorAction: Provide valid session id before manual resync/ops action.

entries.title: Firebase data service unavailable
entries.operatorAction: Check runtime data service initialization and network.

entries.title: Manual resync exception
entries.operatorAction: Collect logs and retry manual resync.

entries.title: Runtime uninitialized
entries.operatorAction: Wait for runtime initialization or restart app.

entries.title: Active game completed
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Active game failed
entries.operatorAction: Inspect runtime logs before restarting session.

entries.title: TCP client disconnected
entries.operatorAction: Reconnect controller-headset link.

entries.title: Session attach context missing
entries.operatorAction: Use build with valid session context wiring and restart runtime.

entries.title: Session attach missing session id
entries.operatorAction: Ensure attach payload includes sessionId.

entries.title: Session attach ownership conflict
entries.operatorAction: Verify therapist/student ownership keys before attach.

entries.title: Session attach restore failed
entries.operatorAction: Retry attach; if repeated, restart runtime and inspect logs.

entries.title: Start game requested without active game
entries.operatorAction: Select game and re-attach session before start.

entries.title: Start game failed
entries.operatorAction: Retry start once; if repeated, inspect runtime logs.

entries.title: Pause requested with no active game
entries.operatorAction: Start or resume game before pause.

entries.title: Pause game failed
entries.operatorAction: Retry pause; if repeated, use stop/end session path.

entries.title: Resume requested with no active game
entries.operatorAction: Attach/start game before resume.

entries.title: Resume from saved state failed
entries.operatorAction: Retry with fresh start or inspect saved-state compatibility.

entries.title: Resume game failed
entries.operatorAction: Retry resume; if repeated, restart runtime session.

entries.title: Stop requested with no active game
entries.operatorAction: No action needed unless flow is blocked.

entries.title: Stop game failed
entries.operatorAction: Use end session fallback and inspect runtime logs.

entries.title: End session failed while stopping game
entries.operatorAction: Retry end session and validate active game shutdown path.

entries.title: Action observed after timeout
entries.operatorAction: Review reaction timing and runtime delay conditions.

entries.title: Adaptive difficulty disabled
entries.operatorAction: No action needed unless adaptive mode was expected.

entries.title: Dataset empty
entries.operatorAction: Collect more interaction events before export.

entries.title: Adaptive decision: decrease difficulty
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Adaptive decision: increase difficulty
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Adaptive decision: keep difficulty
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Adaptive decision: keep difficulty (mixed signals)
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: No pending step
entries.operatorAction: No action needed unless sequence flow is unexpected.

entries.title: Session restored from snapshot
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Sequence step timeout
entries.operatorAction: Check pacing/difficulty and retry sequence.

entries.title: Target matched
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Target mismatch
entries.operatorAction: Check task instructions and interaction accuracy.

entries.title: Task label generated
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: No trace candidates found
entries.operatorAction: Verify source directories/device pull for trace files.

entries.title: Trace file not found
entries.operatorAction: Provide valid trace path and retry.

entries.title: Trace path required
entries.operatorAction: Provide trace path before running export validation.

entries.title: Trace loader uninitialized
entries.operatorAction: Initialize trace loader context before export.

entries.title: Unknown reason code
entries.operatorAction: Inspect logs and map to a stable reason code when possible.

entries.title: Active session matched
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Command precondition not met
entries.operatorAction: Satisfy command precondition and retry.

entries.title: Context not entry/reconnect
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: End session and attach completed
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: End session override used
entries.operatorAction: Review override reason in timeline.

entries.title: Handoff gate cleared
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Persisted gate cleared
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.title: Recovery within allowed window
entries.operatorAction: No action needed.

entries.operatorAction: No action needed.
